product.title: Cortech Endurance 42" Round Top Table - Molded Cylinder Base and Molded Top - Model 668S
product.body_html:
The Cortech Endurance Table with Cylinder Base is ideal for food service and all recreational applications. It has a high load capacity due to its rotational molding technology, while the rounded table top edge increases safety and comfort. Cortech Endurance Tables, like the rest of Cortech's Endurance Series Furniture line, are ideal for continuous use in extreme environments, including compassionate and normative Behavioral Health Care Facilities, Residential Treatment Centers and Facilities, Hospital Psychiatric Units, Correctional Institutions, Mental Health Treatment Centers and other medical and public safety facilities that require the ultimate combination of durability and functional design.

  • Table Top: 42” diameter
  • Solid top or optional Game Top
  • Ideal for use with the Cortech RazorBack chair
  • Constructed of highly durable, one piece, rotationally molded, high impact polyethylene
  • Can be bolted to the floor via concealed pilot holes with Cortech's exclusive Sabre Mount System
  • Base affixes to the table top with tamper resistant screws and can be filled with sand (not included) to weigh down
  • Easy to clean, sanitize, and maintain
  • Tested to ISO 22196 showing a >99% reduction in bacteria
  • Flame Retardant (passes Cal 133 and UL 94 HB)
  • Manufactured to ISO Quality Standards in the USA
  • 10-Year Factory Warranty
  • Flame Retardant (passes Cal 133) - test reports available upon request
  • Colors: Aqua, Black, Blue Gray, Brown, Burgundy, Gray, Green, Indigo, Midnight Blue, Sand, Slate Blue, Stone Gray
  • Made in the USA

About Cortech Endurance Furniture:
The Cortech Endurance intense use furniture line is ideal for use as behavioral health furniture, correctional facility furniture, detention furniture, and Behavioral Healthcare mental health furniture. The Endurance Furniture Series is also a perfect fit for residential institutions, public safety facilities, detention centers, correctional institutions, prisons and any intense or high abuse applications such as drug and alcohol rehabilitation centers and addiction treatment centers.

About Cortech USA:
Cortech USA (Correctional Technologies) manufactures products that are exceptionally durable, designed for use in compassionate and normative behavioral healthcare, corrections, law enforcement, heavy use commercial and industrial environments, parks and recreation, schools, universities, hospitals, emergency and homeless shelters, and other institutions and facilities where safety and durability matter. Cortech products are ideal for extreme use and intensive use environments.
